meta.title: Split Menus
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Split Menus".

steps.title: Coffee
steps.text: Rich, roasted, and endlessly customisable—explore our coffee drinks below.

steps.title: Espresso
steps.text: A concentrated shot of coffee, brewed under pressure for a bold, rich flavour.

steps.title: Latte
steps.text: Espresso combined with steamed milk and a light layer of foam.

steps.title: Tea
steps.text: Light, aromatic, and steeped to order—explore our tea varieties below.

steps.title: Green Tea
steps.text: A lightly oxidised tea with a fresh, grassy flavour.

steps.title: Black Tea
steps.text: A fully oxidised tea with a bold, robust flavour.

UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Split Menus', 'joomlaguide-split-menus', '

A split menu shows one menu in two modules: the top level in a horizontal menu at the top, and the items below the active one in the sidebar.

The playground already has six articles: Coffee, Espresso, Latte, Tea, Green Tea and Black Tea. You add them to the Main Menu in two levels, then make the two menu modules.

This tour follows the tutorial 10.2 Split Menus of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_menus","com_modules"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 10.2 Split Menus', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Menus', '

In the menu on the left, click Menus.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Menus › Main Menu', '

Click Main Menu in Menus.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Create a new menu item', '

Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-items .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Menu item title', '

Type the title:

Coffee

Then click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-item #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Menu Item Type', '
  1. Click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Articles, then Single Article.

The page reloads. When the field shows Single Article, click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-item .input-group:has(#jform_type)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Choose the article', '
  1. At Select Article, click Select.
  2. In the window that opens, click Coffee.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-item .input-group:has(#jform_request_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Parent Item', '

Coffee is a top-level item: leave Parent Item at - No parent -.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'left', '.view-item fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_parent_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Open the save options', '

Five more menu items follow. Click the arrow next to Save & Close.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-item #toolbar-dropdown-save-group .dropdown-toggle-split', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Save & New', '

Click Save & New.

Joomla saves the menu item and opens a new, empty one.

', 9, 'left', '.view-item #save-group-children-save-new .button-save-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Five more menu items', '

Make five more menu items in the same way, each a Single Article with the article of the same name. Click Save & New (the arrow next to Save & Close) after each, except the last:

  1. Title: Tea; Menu Item Type: Single Article; Select Article: Tea; Parent Item: - No parent -
  2. Title: Espresso; Menu Item Type: Single Article; Select Article: Espresso; Parent Item: Coffee
  3. Title: Latte; Menu Item Type: Single Article; Select Article: Latte; Parent Item: Coffee
  4. Title: Green Tea; Menu Item Type: Single Article; Select Article: Green Tea; Parent Item: Tea
  5. Title: Black Tea; Menu Item Type: Single Article; Select Article: Black Tea; Parent Item: Tea

When you have filled in Black Tea, click Next.

', 10, 'top', '.view-item #item-form', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Save the menu item', '

Click Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-item #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=item&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'A menu with two levels', '

The Main Menu now has Coffee and Tea at the top level, each with two items below it.

Next, you make two modules that each show one level of this menu.

', 12, 'top', '#menuitemList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 13, 'right', 'body.com_menus.view-items #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Content › Site Modules', '

Click Site Modules in Content.

', 14, 'right', 'body.com_menus.view-items #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Create a new module', '

Click New.

', 15, 'bottom', '.view-modules .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Menu', '

Click Menu: this module type shows a menu.

', 16, 'right', '.view-select a.comModulesSelectCard[aria-label$=" Menu"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=select&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Module title', '

The first module shows only the top level, at the top of the page. Type the title:

Main Navigation - Top

Then click Next.

', 17, 'bottom', '.view-module #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Only the top level', '
  • Select Menu: Main Menu
  • Start Level: 1
  • End Level: 1
  • Sub-menu Items: Hide

Then click Next.

', 18, 'right', '.view-module #general .col-lg-9', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Position', '

Click the field Position and choose Menu [menu] in the group Cassiopeia: the horizontal menu at the top of the page.

Then click Next.

', 19, 'left', '.view-module fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_position)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Open the save options', '

The second module follows. Click the arrow next to Save & Close.

', 20, 'bottom', '.view-module #toolbar-dropdown-save-group .dropdown-toggle-split', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Save & New', '

Click Save & New.

Joomla saves the module and opens a new, empty menu module.

', 21, 'left', '.view-module #save-group-children-save-new .button-save-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'The sub-menu', '

The second module shows the items below the top-level item the visitor is in. Fill in:

  • Title: Sidebar Sub-menu
  • Select Menu: Main Menu
  • Base Item: leave it empty
  • Start Level: 2
  • End Level: All
  • Sub-menu Items: Show
  • Position: Sidebar-left [sidebar-left]

Then click Next.

', 22, 'top', '.view-module #module-form', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Save the module', '

Click Save & Close.

', 23, 'bottom', '.view-module #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=module&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-split-menus'), 'Well done!', '

Look at your site: click this button with your site\'s name (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar).

  • Click Coffee in the menu at the top: the sidebar shows Espresso and Latte.
  • Click Tea: the sidebar changes to Green Tea and Black Tea.

Because Base Item is empty, the sub-menu follows the section the visitor is in.

', 24, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_modules&view=modules&client_id=0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
